steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Operator: In mathematics, "of" means multiply. So "3/4 of 20" means 3/4 × 20, and "25% of 80" means 25% × 80.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Find 2/3 of £54 | Find 35% of 240 | Increase £180 by 15%

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
